items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Lockjaw said one night, he and Bostick were playing a club up in the Bronx... Well, I'm hip to him, I know how much he played.

ctx.x: Lockjaw said one night, he and Bostick were playing a club up in the Bronx, the 8:45 Club. Well, I'm hip to him, I know how much he played. I been knowing all the time how much he played and he said Bird came in, brought his horn and he's got his name now, he's big. So he come in because Bostic was playing like the Bird style. He hadn't made the records and things like that, so Bird said, 'Let me go up and straighten this cat out and let him know who the boss is, you know?' He said Bird got his horn, boy, and…
ing his thing, you know. And says, -- Lockjaw says, "I didn't have but $2.00, so I just went over to him, says, 'Come on, you can have all this because you need it worse than I do.'"
